description: Get the Usercase script for the connected project, with where to put it per framework. If nothing is connected yet, it opens the browser to connect and says what to tell the user. Use when check_site says the SDK is not running and you are in the site's repository: add the script once to the root layout/document, show the user the diff, then run check_site on the local site to confirm. Do not commit or deploy unless asked. If you have not read the install procedure yet, call the instructions tool with command install first.
name: install_snippet
